sentences.en: Every successful writer has a drawer full of rejection letters.
sentences.zh: 每个成功的作家抽屉里都装满了拒绝信。

sentences.en: By the fiftieth heartbreak, rejection becomes much easier to handle.
sentences.zh: 到了第50次失恋时，被拒绝就变得容易处理多了。

sentences.en: Yanni wants to avoid the risk of rejection by Skura.
sentences.zh: 雅尼想避免被斯库拉拒绝的风险。

senses.zh: 拒绝；退回；剔除摒弃，厌弃，废弃剔除物，废弃物；呕出物排斥
